name: Pennyworth: The Origin of Batman's Butler
description: The origin story of Bruce Wayne's legendary butler, Alfred Pennyworth, a former British SAS soldier who forms a security company in 1960s London and goes to work with young billionaire Thomas Wayne and his wife Martha, before they become Bruce Wayne’s parents.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Recently discharged from the British Special Air Service (SAS), Alfred Pennyworth finds himself at loose ends and endeavors to start a security company.

videos.title: The Landlord's Daughter
videos.overview: Alfred turns down an offer from billionaire businessman Bruce Wayne and instead accepts an assignment that puts him in the crosshairs of one of the East End's most dastardly figures.

videos.title: Martha Kane
videos.overview: Alfred accepts an assignment from photojournalist Martha Kane that turns increasingly dangerous.

videos.title: Lady Penelope
videos.overview: Alfred and Martha Kane take a train ride into the countryside on an assignment, while tragedy strikes in London.

videos.title: Shirley Bassey
videos.overview: John Ripper presents Alfred with an offer. Lord Harwood's fate takes a curious turn.

videos.title: Cilla Black
videos.overview: Martha and Patricia Wayne attend a debauched party with famed magician Aleister Crowley.

videos.title: Julie Christie
videos.overview: While Martha and Thomas confront Crowley over his strange party and the return of Patricia, Alfred and the lads track down the identity of a wanted killer.

videos.title: Sandie Shaw
videos.overview: While Lord Harwood returns to take control of the Raven Society, Alfred, Dave Boy and Bazza form an unlikely alliance with the Sykes Sisters.

videos.title: Alma Cogan
videos.overview: Alfred, Thomas and Martha become entangled in an assassination plot against Lord Harwood.

videos.title: Marianne Faithfull
videos.overview: After a member of the British royalty is abducted, Alfred must take a side in the struggle. Meanwhile, Lord Harwood uses those closest to Alfred to remove him from the game.

videos.title: The Heavy Crown
videos.overview: Alfred Pennyworth tries to profit off a war-torn London that threatens to be overrun by the fascist Raven Union.

videos.title: The Burning Bridge
videos.overview: Alfred's plans for his departure to America are put on hold when someone close to him is put in danger. Thomas enlists the help of an old foe, Aleister Crowley.

videos.title: The Belt and Welt
videos.overview: While Crowley enacts his plan with unintended results, Alfred, Bazza and Daveboy set out to find out who had the nerve to steal from them.

videos.title: The Hunted Fox
videos.overview: Still haunted by tragedy, Alfred agrees to join Gully's team on an upcoming job. Meanwhile, pressure begins to take its toll on Harwood and direct him toward Project Stormcloud.

videos.title: The Bleeding Heart
videos.overview: While Alfred and Daveboy run one last job for Gully in order to buy tickets to America, tensions ratchet up at Raven Union HQ between Harwood and his lieutenants.

videos.title: The Rose and Thorn
videos.overview: While Alfred is enlisted to help extract Lucius Fox from Raven headquarters, Prime Minister Aziz sets in motion a plan that pits Aleister Crowley against John Ripper.

videos.title: The Bloody Mary
videos.overview: While Alfred prepares to depart England for good, Bet and Peggy Sykes set out to rescue their old friend Lord Harwood from imminent danger.

videos.title: The Hangman's Noose
videos.overview: While Salt sits down with the League to discuss peace, Alfred confronts Gully to do the same. And Martha finally comes clean to Thomas about her dilemma.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: With less than 48 hours, Alfred, Thomas & Martha concoct a plan to infiltrate Raven headquarters with Daveboy and Lucius to steal Project Stormcloud.

videos.title: The Lion and Lamb
videos.overview: Salt is hell-bent on releasing Project Stormcloud upon London… unless Alfred and his mates can stop it.

videos.title: Well to Do
videos.overview: 1972. Hired to rescue a young woman believed to be under the spell of a dangerous hippie cult, Pennyworth seeks help from a preoccupied Bet, while Thomas and Martha field a surprise visit from Patrick.

videos.title: Many Clouds
videos.overview: While grappling with the true nature of Martha’s work, Thomas agrees to help his father – and seeks Alfie’s assistance. Meanwhile, after being questioned by Aziz, Pennyworth escalates his search for answers at the ashram.

videos.title: Comply or Die
videos.overview: While Pennyworth deals with an old friend, Daveboy grapples with his conscience in a very public way. As tensions run high in the Wayne household, Thomas plots with Patrick, and Martha receives a proposition… and warning.

videos.title: Silver Birch
videos.overview: After Thomas is thrown behind bars, Patrick offers Alfie and a hesitant Daveboy a hefty sum to break his son out of jail.

videos.title: Rhyme 'n’ Reason
videos.overview: As Martha and Thomas attempt to heal and rebuild, an unexpected visit from Patricia threatens to derail their progress. Meanwhile, Alfie is hired to keep an eye on Zahra Khin, the leader of a separatist group.

videos.title: Hedgehunter
videos.overview: While Alfie forces his way into Khin’s rescue mission, Bet squares off against John Salt, and Thomas finds himself back in Gotham.

videos.title: Don't Push It
videos.overview: To set things right, Alfie and Daveboy search for a dangerous secret prison in the Hebrides, which generates its power by triggering its inhabitants’ most traumatic memories.

videos.title: Red Marauder
videos.overview: After a power station attack, Alfie, Daveboy, and Martha attempt to help Gully Troy restore public opinion of PWEs. Meanwhile, Dr. Glubb tries to stop Foulkes’ reckless use of Lullaby.

videos.title: Rag Trade
videos.overview: Thomas’ hesitant return home is further complicated by Samantha’s kidnapping. Sally involves Daveboy in the aftermath of Foulkes’ dinner party. An increasingly concerned Lucius seeks to free the PWEs.

videos.title: Highland Wedding
videos.overview: As the city further descends into a Lullaby-induced chaos, Alfie and Martha break into L7 to save Lucius – and the rest of the world.
